settings.heading: WHAT'S INSIDE
settings.subhead: We believe snack time should be fun AND worry-free. Here's exactly what goes into every Snacklace — no mystery, just yumminess!
settings.warning_text: Our Snacklaces are handmade in a kitchen that also handles wheat, milk, soy, tree nuts, peanuts. If you have allergies, please check with a grown-up before you snack!
settings.safety_notice: The string is not for eating — just the snacks! Snacklaces are meant to be enjoyed fresh and worn with a grown-up nearby for little ones.
